chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags rgyas sbyang ba ni/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ swa bhā ba bi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba bi shud+dho3 haṃ/ yo byad ma dag pa rnams sbyangs te skyon thams cad dang bral bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ de bzhin du/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel ba ni/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba'i tshigs bar pa rnams bcag pa dpral bar bzhag la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ mgron so so'i mos pa dang mthun pa'i yo byad kyis nam mkha'i khams khyab par gyur/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags rgyas bsgyur ba ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'i kha gyen du phye ste mthe bong bsnol la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdzas rnams mgron so so'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi bar byed pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyis sngags rgyas spyod par dbang bar bya ba ni/ g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa'i mdzub mo sgreng*/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ 'phags pa rnams kyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin mtha' yas pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyi dbang po lnga'i spyod yul du 'dod pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes par 'byung bar gyur/ ye shes skar mda'i sngags rgyas thob par bya ba ni/ g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa snying gar bzhag /g.yon mthe bong lag pa'i mthil du bzhag pa'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ dzñā na a wa lo ki te na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha ba sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hṛ da ya dz+wa la ni swā hā/ lus zhing rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa 'phags pa rnams la phul pas mnyes shing sems can rnams yo byad rgyal pham dang rtsod pa med par so so'i mos pa bzhin thob par gyur/

dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'am lha mgon spyi'i sngags rgyas dbang du bsgyur ba ni/ sor mo nang du bsnol ba'i rdo rje bsdams/ mthe bong gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs la/ na mas+sa man+ta bud+dhā naṃ gra he shwa ra pra bha dz+yo ti ni ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ mgron thams cad kyang dam tshig gi dbang gis bdag la 'go zhing phan pa dang bde ba'i phrin las 'ba' zhig bsgrub par gyur/ phyag rgya rnams phyogs bcur bskor zhing sngags rnams lan gsum la sogs pa brjod/ na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// 'jig rten khams 'dir ma lus pa// thogs pa med par 'byung bar shog / ces bden tshig gis kyang byin brlab/ mkhyen brtse'i gter bum spyi sgrub las khol du phyung ba'o/// /
